references.text: God's instruction to Moses to overlay the table of showbread with pure gold and make a gold rim around it. Exodus 37:11 describes Bezalel's execution of this command.
Parallel description of the ark of the covenant, which was also overlaid with pure gold and given a gold rim around it, using the same craftsmanship technique as applied to the table of showbread.
The altar of incense was also overlaid with pure gold and given a gold rim around it, following the same construction method as the table of showbread.
Description of how the ark of the covenant was overlaid with pure gold and given a gold rim, using the same technique applied to the table of showbread in verse 11.
The altar of incense was overlaid with pure gold and given a gold rim around it, receiving treatment similar to that of the table of showbread.
Solomon's temple also contained a gold-overlaid table for the showbread, continuing the tradition from the tabernacle.
The book of Hebrews mentions the table and the showbread as part of the holy furnishings of the tabernacle, pointing back to the construction described in Exodus.
Direct fulfillment of the earlier instruction regarding the table for the showbread.
